mechanism: Atazanavir may increase ethambutol levels through CYP3A4 inhibition, potentially elevating optic toxicity risk; additionally, both drugs can cause hyperuricemia and may have additive effects on bilirubin metabolism.
action: Monitor for ethambutol-related optic toxicity (visual acuity, color discrimination); consider baseline and periodic ophthalmologic assessment; monitor serum uric acid levels and renal function; dose adjustment of ethambutol may be necessary.
